entities.name: Ravi Sengir
entities.description: A former planeswalker who rang the Apocalypse Chime, destroying both factions of Ulgrotha's Great War, was trapped for centuries in a coffin, and is now the adopted grandmother and tutor of Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Originally the baron's son revived after death, now a full-fledged vampire who freed Ravi and calls her Grandmother Sengir.

entities.name: The local baron
entities.description: The cruel black-magic baron, father of the boy who became Baron Sengir, killed by rats commanded by Ravi.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The backwater plane where the Great War between the Tolgath and the Ancients reached its peak and where Ravi now lives.

entities.name: Tolgath
entities.description: A group of young planeswalkers opposed by the Ancients, with which Ravi was affiliated.

entities.name: Ancients
entities.description: The rival faction of planeswalkers opposed to the Tolgath.

entities.name: Apocalypse Chime
entities.description: A mighty artifact given to Ravi by her master, which destroyed both warring parties when she rang it.

entities.name: Great Destruction
entities.description: The result of ringing the Apocalypse Chime, forming the Dead Zone and killing almost all creatures on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Dead Zone
entities.description: The region formed by the Great Destruction disrupting Ulgrotha's mana channels.

entities.name: Basalt Spire
entities.description: The place where Ravi hid herself in a magical coffin.

entities.name: Plague Rats
entities.description: Rats that infested Ravi's village and that she later controlled with a song.

entities.name: Ihsan
entities.description: A figure who left Ulgrotha with Sengir at the head of a vampire army.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Ravi defended Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Dwarven Gate
entities.description: The gate through which Sengir and Ihsan left Ulgrotha.

events.summary: A plague of rats kills most of Ravi's village, including her mother; she meets the baron's son, who teaches her a song to control the rats to kill the baron.
events.quote: To do this, the boy taught her a song that could control the rats.

events.summary: Ravi commands the rats to kill the baron after finding him working on her mother's corpse; the baron's boy is revived by his father's last spell.
events.quote: Ravi took her opportunity and ordered the rats to kill the baron.

events.summary: Ravi is introduced to the new Baron Sengir, who is intolerant of light.
events.quote: Ravi was thus introduced to the new Baron Sengir .

events.summary: At the peak of the Great War on Ulgrotha, Ravi rings the Apocalypse Chime, destroying both parties and causing the Great Destruction.
events.quote: Ravi rang the chime and destroyed both parties, resulting in the Great Destruction that formed the Dead Zone

events.summary: Ravi hides in a magical coffin in the Basalt Spire and is trapped in it for centuries, driven mad.
events.quote: Trapped, Ravi lay in stasis, awake, unable to dream, aware of every passing second for the centuries she was locked within the artifact.

events.summary: The vampire Baron Sengir frees Ravi, neither recognizing the other, and takes her to his castle as Grandmother Sengir and his tutor.
events.quote: she was freed by her childhood friend, the Baron Sengir , now a full-fledged vampire

events.summary: On the eve of the Mending, Sengir and Ihsan leave Ulgrotha at the head of a vampire army; Ravi stays and later defends Ulgrotha in the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Grandmother Sengir stayed behind on Ulgrotha, and participated in the plane's defense during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

relations.note: Tutor of the Baron, whose magic comes from her spells.

relations.quote: the adopted grandmother of Baron Sengir
She was affiliated with the Tolgath

relations.note: Ordered the rats to kill him.
relations.quote: Ravi took her opportunity and ordered the rats to kill the baron.

relations.note: Father of the boy who became Baron Sengir.
relations.quote: He revealed that he was the baron's son

relations.note: Tolgath fought the rival Ancients; she destroyed both with the chime.
relations.quote: a group of young planeswalkers opposed by the rival Ancients
